market_question: Will Justin Thomas win the 2026 PGA Championship?
reasoning: Justin Thomas is a two-time PGA Champion (2017, 2022) and a perennial top contender, normally carrying a 2–5% win probability in any major. The market’s implied 0.3% is drastically too low, even accounting for the long time horizon and field strength. This mispricing is large and persistent.
evidence_points: Winner of the PGA Championship in 2017 and 2022
Consistent world top-25 ranking and multiple other major top-10s
Typical betting odds for elite golfers in a major assign a 2–5% chance, not 0.3%
sources_consulted: General knowledge of major championship betting markets
